cards.title: Arrive + settle in
cards.summary: Land, drop bags at Yohan's place in Avondale, regroup, then head out for dinner.

sections.label: Details
sections.body: Crashing at Yohan's tonight (and stashing luggage here again on Sunday before we leave). Drop bags, freshen up, then roll to dinner.

cards.title: Dinner — pick one
cards.summary: Three north-side spots. Heads up: only Pizza Lobo is near Yohan's (Logan Square) — the other two are up in Andersonville, ~15 min further.

sections.label: Pizza Lobo — Logan Square (closest)
sections.body:
Casual pizza + cocktails, ~10 min from Yohan's. Easy, no-fuss option for night one.
3000 W Fullerton Ave

sections.label: Little Bad Wolf — Andersonville
sections.body:
Burgers, baos, tacos and strong cocktails in a dark, cozy room. ~15 min north.
1541 W Bryn Mawr Ave

sections.label: Hopleaf — Andersonville
sections.body:
Belgian beer mecca + gastropub (mussels & frites, the famous CB&J). Right by Little Bad Wolf.
5148 N Clark St

cards.title: Brunch — Tweet or Pancake Café
cards.summary: Both up north near Yohan's, easy to hit before we head downtown to drop bags.

sections.label: Tweet — Uptown
sections.body:
Quirky, beloved New American brunch (cash-friendly, BYO from Big Chicks next door). Opens 9 AM.
5020 N Sheridan Rd

sections.label: Pancake Café — Lakeview
sections.body:
Family-run, big homestyle breakfast plates. Opens 8 AM, so the earlier option if we're moving.
3805 N Broadway

cards.title: The Westin Michigan Avenue
cards.summary: Stash the bags before the boat tour, do the real check-in after lunch. Booked Jun 12–14.

sections.label: Details
sections.body: Front desk will hold luggage before the room's ready — drop and go. Rooms open 2–4 PM; circle back to check in and chill after the cruise + lunch.

sections.label: Location
sections.body: Right on the Magnificent Mile, ~10 min from the river cruise dock. Easy walk to dinner-zone via cab/L.

cards.title: Architecture River Cruise
cards.summary: Chicago's First Lady (Chicago Architecture Center cruise). Booked ✓. Board at the Riverwalk, SE corner of Michigan Ave & Wacker.

image.alt: Chicago River and downtown architecture from the Riverwalk

location.name: Chicago's First Lady — Riverwalk dock
location.address: 112 E Wacker Dr (SE corner, Michigan Ave & Wacker)

sections.label: Details
sections.body: Get there ~15 min early for boarding. Walk down to the lower-level Riverwalk on the southeast side of the Michigan Ave bridge. Grab a drink onboard.

sections.label: After: light lunch (2 PM)
sections.body: Cruise ends right on the Riverwalk — easy to grab a light lunch nearby (Riverwalk patios, or anything along Mag Mile) before heading back to check in.

cards.title: Café Ba-Ba-Reeba
cards.summary: Spanish tapas, paella and sangria in Lincoln Park. ⚠️ Needs a reservation — book it now.

sections.label: Details
sections.body: Chicago's original tapas spot (since 1985). Order a spread of hot + cold tapas and at least one paella for the table; pitchers of sangria are the move.

sections.label: Logistics
sections.body: Lincoln Park — ~10 min from the iO Theater right after, so timing lines up for the 7:30 show.

cards.title: iO Theater — Improvised Shakespeare
cards.summary: A full Shakespearean play, improvised from one audience suggestion. Booked ✓.

image.alt: iO Theater — photo to be added

sections.label: Details
sections.body: Arrive a bit early — there's a bar and rooftop. ~10 min from dinner, near Goose Island.

cards.title: Indiana Dunes (rental car)
cards.summary: The leaning option. Rent a car, drive ~1 hr to the Lake Michigan shoreline for dunes + beach.

image.alt: Indiana Dunes National Park on Lake Michigan

location.name: Indiana Dunes National Park
location.address: 1215 N State Road 49, Porter, IN (visitor center)

sections.label: Details
sections.body: Big dunes right on Lake Michigan. Do the 3 Dune Challenge (1.5 mi, 3 steep dunes) then hang on the beach. Pack swimsuits + towels.

sections.label: Logistics
sections.body: Need a rental car — ~50 mi / 1 hr each way. There's a small park entrance fee. Leave by ~9–9:30 to be set up by 10, back by ~4–5 for dinner.

cards.title: City day: beach → blues → sauna
cards.summary: The no-car alternative: lakefront, live blues, and a recovery session. ⚠️ Sweathouz needs a 5 PM booking.

sections.label: Beach
sections.body: Walk/cab to the lakefront — North Avenue Beach is the classic (volleyball, the boathouse bar).

sections.label: Blues
sections.body: Lincoln Park has two legendary clubs across the street from each other: Kingston Mines and B.L.U.E.S. on Halsted. Afternoon/early sets, then dinner.

sections.label: Sweathouz (book 5 PM ⚠️)
sections.body: Private infrared sauna + cold plunge to reset. Old Town location: 1439 N Wells St. Reserve the 5 PM slot ahead of time.

cards.title: BOKA
cards.summary: Michelin-starred New American in Lincoln Park — the big dinner of the trip. ⚠️ Reserve well ahead.

sections.label: Details
sections.body: Elevated, seasonal, beautifully plated — dress it up a notch. In the theater district near Steppenwolf. Book as far ahead as you can; prime times go fast.

cards.title: Last brunch + checkout
cards.summary: One more brunch, grab the bags, head out.

sections.label: Plan
sections.body: Ask the front desk Saturday night about a late checkout. Sunday: brunch near the hotel (River North / Gold Coast has tons of options), check out, swing by Yohan's for any stashed luggage, and roll out by 3 PM.
